day4_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day4_intro.text: Boss is impressed you're moving the gear. Keep it up and you'll be proper looked after, bro.

boss_notice.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
boss_notice.text: He knows everyone, bro. Especially people making him money. Stay on his good side.

day5_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day5_intro.text: Big things coming bro. Boss planning something that'll put the Gumboots on the map proper.

big_plans.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
big_plans.text: Can't say too much but... let's just say some dairies gonna have a bad night soon. Not yours though, you're with us.

day6_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day6_intro.text: Heard about Tane? Police got him. Boss is proper pissed. Might be coming to see you himself, bro.

boss_visit.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
boss_visit.text: Just be respectful to the boss and you'll be sweet. He values loyalty above everything, bro.

day7_intro.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
day7_intro.text: Final day bro. Whatever happens tonight, remember: loyalty is everything in this game.

final_end.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
final_end.text: You're one of us now bro. Look after the family and the family looks after you.

end.speaker: Sam "Big Lad" Tavita
end.text: Sweet as, bro. Can't watch the game empty handed—gotta be fully geared for yellin' at every try!
